exposure: prostaglandin E2 vaginal insert for cervical ripening
cohort: 294 women undergoing induction of labor for decreased fetal movements at or beyond 39 weeks gestation
finding: Both prostaglandin E2 vaginal insert and cervical ripening balloon were found to be safe and effective methods for cervical ripening in women presenting with decreased fetal movements at term, with no significant difference in cesarean delivery rates between the groups.
